title: Preliminary design, operation and maintenance of protection works downstream of spillways - Guidelines.
clause_1_scope: This standard lays down guidelines for preliminary design, operation and maintenance of protection works downstream of spillways.
clause_3_terminology: operation and maintenance of protection works downstream of spillways

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
